me.char321.sfadvancements.api

Class Advancement

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.char321.sfadvancements.api.Advancement

  • public class Advancement
extends java.lang.Object
    An advancement that appears in the advancements gui and players can complete. When all of an advancement's criteria are completed, it becomes shiny.
